summary.zh: 沉浸阅读器是 SJT-bright 开发的本地电子书阅读工具，支持 EPUB、TXT 和文字型 PDF，结合立体双页、雨窗与雪景、氛围音乐、划线笔记和阅读记录。无需账号，个人书籍与记录保存在本机。
summary.en: Immersive Reader by SJT-bright is a local-first ebook reader for EPUB, TXT and text-based PDF. It combines selectable two-page text, rain and snow scenes, ambient music, highlights, notes and reading history. No reader account is required; personal books and records stay on your computer.

features.zhTitle: EPUB / TXT / PDF 文字导入
features.enTitle: EPUB, TXT and PDF text import
features.zh: 拖入或选择可重排 EPUB、TXT、文字型 PDF。TXT 识别 UTF-8、UTF-16、GB18030 / GBK、Big5，结合文件名提取书名作者并自动分章；PDF 按页面坐标重组文字。长文件转换提供进度与取消入口。
features.en: Drop or select reflowable EPUB, TXT or text-based PDF. TXT detection covers UTF-8, UTF-16, GB18030 / GBK and Big5, with filename metadata and automatic chapter splitting. PDF text is reconstructed from page coordinates. Long conversions expose progress and cancellation.

features.zh: 保留原书封面，无封面时生成书名封面；按书名或作者搜索，按最近打开、导入时间、书名、进度排序。可从书架查看目录和各章进度，继续上次阅读，或删除书籍。
features.en: Keep embedded covers or use generated title covers. Search by title or author and sort by last opened, import time, title or progress. Inspect chapter contents and progress from the shelf, resume reading or remove a book.

features.zhTitle: 立体双页与可选中文字
features.zh: 书桌与风景中的浅色双页带柔和书缝、参数化纸面受光和翻页动效；正文仍是可以选中、搜索、划线的真实文字。支持左右翻页、连续滚动、宋体 / 黑体 / 楷体、字号、行距、页宽和排版密度调整。
features.en: A light two-page book combines a soft gutter, parameterized paper lighting and page-turn transitions. The text remains selectable, searchable and highlightable. Choose pagination or continuous scroll; tune font family, size, line spacing, page width and density.

features.zhTitle: 目录、页码、全书搜索与进度
features.enTitle: Contents, page navigation, search and progress
features.zh: 目录可过滤章节，展开页码并直接跳章或跳页，显示每章已读比例；鼠标悬停可展开，触屏和键盘也可操作。支持中英文全书搜索、返回跳转前位置、关闭重开恢复进度；进度归零保留笔记和书签。
features.en: Filter chapters, expand page numbers, jump by chapter or page, and inspect chapter read coverage. Hover, touch and keyboard interactions are supported. Search across chapters in Chinese or English, return to the previous reading position, restore progress on reopening, or reset progress while retaining notes and bookmarks.

features.zh: 提供慢 / 适中 / 快预设，以及滚动速度、每页停留、章末停留的细调。自动阅读联动计时；手动翻页时重置等待时间后继续，离开页面或切书时暂停。全屏、隐藏工具和快捷键帮助专注阅读。
features.en: Slow, medium and fast presets accompany controls for scrolling speed, page dwell and chapter-end pauses. Automatic reading starts the timer. Manual navigation restarts the wait while keeping it running; leaving the page or switching books pauses it. Fullscreen, hidden controls and shortcuts support focus.

features.zhTitle: 13 种场景与自定义图片 / 视频
features.enTitle: 13 scenes and custom images or videos
features.zh: 内置群山黎明、极光夜空、双色流体、花园、草原、森林、湖畔、雨庭、雪原，以及书桌、山谷、咖啡厅、山崖四种立体书环境。可上传、命名和删除自己的图片或静音视频；固定一张、按早晚时段或按分钟轮换，并设置切换渐变。
features.en: Built-in scenes include mountain dawn, aurora, fluid colors, gardens, grassland, forest, lake, rain garden, snow field and four book settings: desk, valley, cafe and cliff. Upload, rename and remove images or muted videos. Use a fixed scene, time-of-day slots or interval rotation with crossfades.

features.zhTitle: 雨窗、落雪与文字可读性保护
features.zh: 雨 / 雪 / 晴天可切换，支持强度和动态开关；高级设置可调雾气、微风、折射、景深、远处闪电等。提供专注阅读、轻氛围、完整场景预设。依据正文区域的背景明暗调整文字与保护底色，并尊重系统减少动态效果设置。
features.en: Switch rain, snow or clear weather, control intensity and motion, and tune mist, breeze, refraction, depth and distant lightning. Focus, light atmosphere and full scene presets are available. Text color and protective shading adapt to the background behind the reading area and honor reduced-motion settings.

features.zhTitle: 原创音乐、环境声与官方音乐链接
features.enTitle: Original music, ambient sounds and official music links
features.zh: 内置六首原创程序合成氛围音乐；可导入本地 MP3 / WAV / OGG / M4A 等，排序播放列表、拖动进度、调音量，选择列表循环、单曲循环、顺序或随机播放，设置淡入淡出及睡眠定时。另有雨声、落雪、海浪、山风、溪流、篝火、虫鸣、白 / 粉 / 棕噪十种环境声；网易云与 QQ 音乐通过官方外链或官方打开入口使用。
features.en: Six original synthesized tracks accompany local MP3 / WAV / OGG / M4A playback, sortable playlists, seeking, volume, list or single-track repeat, sequential and shuffle modes, fades and a sleep timer. Ten ambient modes cover rain, snow, waves, wind, stream, fire, insects and white / pink / brown noise. NetEase and QQ Music use official embeds or official opening links.

features.zhTitle: 划线、心得、书签与 Markdown 导出
features.enTitle: Highlights, notes, bookmarks and Markdown export
features.zh: 选中文字即可划线或写想法，笔记按书保存，可编辑心得、回到对应原文，收藏当前位置为书签。划线与书签分区展示，删除支持撤销；单本书的划线、心得和书签可导出为 Markdown。
features.en: Select text to highlight it or add a comment. Notes belong to their book and can be edited or opened at the original passage. Bookmark the current position; highlights and bookmarks have separate sections. Deletions can be undone, and each book’s notes export as Markdown.

features.zhTitle: 每日目标、16 周热力图与阅读成就
features.enTitle: Daily goals, a 16-week heatmap and achievements
features.zh: 记录今日与累计阅读时长、连续天数、最近阅读和按累计时长解锁的成就。16 周日期宫格支持鼠标、键盘和触屏查看完整日期与分钟数；每日目标显示剩余时间或达标状态。页面转入后台时暂停计时，历史可清空。
features.en: Track today’s and total reading time, streaks, recent sessions and time-based achievements. A 16-week daily grid exposes dates and minute counts on hover, keyboard focus or touch. Daily goals show remaining time or completion. Timing pauses in the background, and history can be cleared.

features.zhTitle: 本地保存、备份恢复与积累库联动
features.enTitle: Local storage, backup and knowledge-library integration
features.zh: 浏览器 IndexedDB 与本机 SQLite 镜像保存资料；完整备份包含书籍、背景、音乐、笔记、位置与设置。恢复时可合并或覆盖，并先下载恢复前快照。可独立运行，也可通过本机接口及书籍 / 笔记链接与配套个人积累库联动。
features.en: Browser IndexedDB and a local SQLite mirror preserve your library. Full backups include books, backgrounds, music, notes, positions and settings. Restore by merging or replacing, with a pre-restore snapshot downloaded first. Use it independently or integrate with a companion knowledge library through local APIs and book / note links.

faq.zhQ: 沉浸阅读器是什么，适合哪些使用场景？
faq.zhA: 它是 SJT-bright 的个人本地电子书阅读项目。适合想在雨窗、雪景或书桌环境中读自己 EPUB / TXT，并同时做划线笔记、听背景音乐和记录阅读习惯的人。源码可下载并在本机运行。
faq.enQ: What is Immersive Reader and who is it for?
faq.enA: It is SJT-bright’s local ebook-reading project, intended for reading your own EPUB / TXT with atmospheric backgrounds, annotations, music and reading-habit records. Download the source and run it locally.

faq.zhQ: 支持哪些文件？能读扫描 PDF、MOBI 或加密书吗？
faq.zhA: 当前支持可重排 EPUB、TXT 和具有文字层的 PDF。PDF 导入提取文字，不保留原页面图片与版式；扫描 PDF 需先用其他工具 OCR。固定版式 / DRM 加密书、MOBI / AZW3 不是当前承诺支持的格式。
faq.enQ: Which formats are supported? What about scanned PDF, MOBI or DRM?
faq.enA: Reflowable EPUB, TXT and PDF with a text layer are supported. PDF import extracts text rather than preserving page images and layout. Scans need external OCR first. Fixed-layout or DRM books and MOBI / AZW3 are not supported claims.

faq.zhQ: 如何在 Mac、Windows 或 Linux 启动？
faq.zhA: 解压完整源码，Mac 运行 sh start.sh 或 start.command；Windows 运行 start.bat；Linux 运行 python3 scripts/serve.py --port 8940。打开 http://127.0.0.1:8940/，保持服务运行。需要现代 Chrome / Edge，以及 Node.js 或 Python；无需 npm 安装。macOS 已有实际验收，Windows / Linux 启动入口尚未分别实机验收。
faq.enQ: How do I run it on Mac, Windows or Linux?
faq.enA: Extract the complete source. On Mac run sh start.sh or start.command; on Windows use start.bat; on Linux run python3 scripts/serve.py --port 8940. Keep the service running and open http://127.0.0.1:8940/. A modern Chrome / Edge browser and Node.js or Python are required; npm installation is unnecessary. macOS has been tested; Windows / Linux launchers have not had separate on-device acceptance.

faq.zhQ: 无需账号是否意味着完全没有联网？
faq.zhA: 阅读器没有用户账号；本地解析、书库、内置音源和环境声不需要外部读书服务。网易云 / QQ 官方播放器和外部链接需要联网，第三方服务可收到相应请求。公开项目主页仅用于介绍，不接收个人书籍。
faq.enQ: Does no account mean no network activity at all?
faq.enA: The reader has no reader account. Local parsing, your library, built-in tracks and ambient sound do not require an external reading service. Official music embeds and external links need internet and involve their respective services. The public project site provides information and does not accept personal books.

faq.zhQ: 书籍、进度和笔记存在哪里？会自动云同步吗？
faq.zhA: 存于本机浏览器 IndexedDB，并由本机服务镜像至 SQLite。默认磁盘目录为当前用户主目录下的 Library/Application Support/immersive-reader-app/library。不同浏览器或地址的缓存互相独立，迁移前请导出备份。当前没有账号式跨设备云同步。
faq.enQ: Where do books and notes live? Is there automatic cloud sync?
faq.enA: They live in browser IndexedDB and a local SQLite mirror, by default under Library/Application Support/immersive-reader-app/library in the current user’s home directory. Browser and address changes produce separate caches. Export backups for migration; account-based cross-device cloud sync is not provided.

faq.zhQ: 立体双页是否还能选字、搜索和记笔记？
faq.zhA: 可以。双页视觉基于真实 DOM 正文、透视和纸面光照，是 2.5D 近似；文字没有被烘焙成图片。选字、搜索、划线与原文定位仍可使用。
faq.enQ: Can I still select, search and annotate the two-page text?
faq.enA: Yes. The visual book uses DOM text, perspective and paper lighting as a 2.5D approximation; text is not flattened into images. Selection, search, highlighting and source-location navigation remain available.

faq.zhQ: 自动阅读手动翻页后会停止吗？
faq.zhA: 1.9.3 中手动翻页会重置自动阅读的等待时间并继续。换书、回到首页、进入后台、按 Escape 或读到书末会暂停；刷新不会自行开启自动阅读。
faq.enQ: Does manual navigation stop automatic reading?
faq.enA: In 1.9.3 manual navigation resets the wait and continues. Switching books, returning home, backgrounding the page, Escape or reaching the end pauses it. Refreshing does not start automatic reading by itself.

faq.zhQ: 能设置自己的图片和视频、关闭雨雪吗？
faq.zhA: 可以上传本地图像或浏览器支持的视频，视频静音循环；可切换固定、时段和定时轮换。选择晴天、关闭天气或使用专注预设可减少画面干扰，也尊重系统减少动态效果。
faq.enQ: Can I use my own background and disable weather?
faq.enA: Upload local images or browser-supported videos, which loop muted. Fixed, time-of-day and interval modes are available. Clear weather, disabled effects or the focus preset reduce visual motion, with system reduced-motion settings honored.

faq.zhQ: 有哪些背景声音，内置音乐从哪里来？
faq.zhA: 十种环境声由浏览器程序合成：雨、雪、海浪、山风、溪流、篝火、虫鸣与三种色噪。六首内置音乐同样由项目生成脚本合成，没有取用他人的采样录音；可另行导入自己的本地音乐。
faq.enQ: What ambient sounds are included and where does the music come from?
faq.enA: Ten modes are synthesized in the browser: rain, snow, waves, wind, stream, fire, insects and three colors of noise. The six music tracks are generated by this project’s script without third-party sampled recordings. You can also import local music.

faq.zhQ: 网易云和 QQ 音乐是否保证所有歌曲都能播放？
faq.zhA: 不保证。项目使用官方外链播放器或官方打开入口，播放受歌曲授权、平台及浏览器环境影响；不提供会员解锁、音频代理或非官方账号接口。本地音频是可独立使用的路径。
faq.enQ: Will every NetEase or QQ Music song play?
faq.enA: No guarantee is made. Official embeds or opening links are subject to platform availability, track rights and browser behavior. The project provides no membership bypass, audio proxy or unofficial account API. Local playback is independent.

faq.zhQ: 阅读进度与阅读时长有什么区别？
faq.zhA: 进度按实际显示过的书页区间记录，不把跳到末页直接当作读完整本；目录同时显示各章已读比例。时长记录当前活跃阅读计时，提供目标、热力图和成就，不等同于对阅读理解程度的测量。
faq.enQ: How do progress and reading time differ?
faq.enA: Progress tracks page ranges actually displayed rather than treating a jump to the last page as a completed book. Chapter coverage is visible in the contents. Time records active timed reading for goals, heatmaps and achievements; it does not measure comprehension.

faq.zhQ: 如何备份与迁移，笔记能单独导出吗？
faq.zhA: 书架面板可导出包含全部书籍和媒体的完整 JSON 备份；恢复可选择合并或覆盖，并先保存恢复前快照。笔记面板另可按书导出 Markdown，包含划线、心得和书签。
faq.enQ: How do backup, migration and note export work?
faq.enA: Export a complete JSON backup with books and media from the shelf panel. Restore by merging or replacing after a pre-restore snapshot. The notes panel separately exports each book’s highlights, comments and bookmarks as Markdown.

faq.zhQ: 项目是否开源，能否商用整个雨窗版本？
faq.zhA: 原创代码在 MIT 许可下开源；第三方组件保留原许可。当前 js/rain-shaders.js 含 Heartfelt 衍生效果，适用 CC BY-NC-SA 3.0。它带非商业限制，因此完整雨窗包不是全部采用 OSI 开源许可证，也不能一概视为可商用。请查看 LICENSE-NOTES.md。
faq.enQ: What is the license? Can the full rain-glass bundle be used commercially?
faq.enA: Original code is open-sourced under MIT; third-party components retain their licenses. js/rain-shaders.js includes a Heartfelt-derived effect under CC BY-NC-SA 3.0. That non-commercial restriction means the full rain bundle is not entirely OSI-licensed or unrestricted for commercial use. See LICENSE-NOTES.md.

faq.zhQ: 这是微软的 Immersive Reader 吗？
faq.zhA: 不是。本项目的完整标识是 SJT-bright/immersive-reader（沉浸阅读器），是独立的本地电子书阅读项目；与 Microsoft / Azure Immersive Reader 无隶属关系。
faq.enA: No. Its complete identity is SJT-bright/immersive-reader, also named 沉浸阅读器. It is an independent local ebook reader, with no affiliation to Microsoft / Azure Immersive Reader.
